description: This file contains implementation of qualifier handling, validation, and joining logic for shader language qualifiers in the ANGLE project, including classes, methods, and qualifier checks.

classes.name: TTypeQualifier
classes.description: Represents a set of qualifiers for shader variables, including layout, memory, precision, and scope.

classes.name: TTypeQualifierBuilder
classes.description: Builds and validates sequences of qualifiers for shader variables and parameters.

classes.name: TInvariantQualifierWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for invariant qualifier with rank for ordering.

classes.name: TInterpolationQualifierWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for interpolation qualifiers with rank for ordering.

classes.name: TLayoutQualifierWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for layout qualifiers with rank for ordering.

classes.name: TStorageQualifierWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for storage qualifiers with rank for ordering.

classes.name: TMemoryQualifierWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for memory qualifiers with rank for ordering.

classes.name: TPrecisionQualifierWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper for precision qualifiers with rank for ordering.

methods.name: JoinLayoutQualifiers
methods.description: Merges two layout qualifiers, checking for conflicts and combining their properties.

methods.name: GetVariableTypeQualifierFromSortedSequence
methods.description: Constructs a variable's type qualifier from a sorted sequence of qualifiers.

methods.name: GetParameterTypeQualifierFromSortedSequence
methods.description: Constructs a parameter's type qualifier from a sorted sequence of qualifiers.
